title: fix(kimi): keep agent_thought_chunk when replaying a resumed session
context:
session/load's replay branch only tracked user/agent_message_chunk
speakers, so agent_thought_chunk fell through to the "no active_turn"
branch and was silently dropped — a resumed Kimi session showed tool
calls and text but zero thinking, even when the raw wire.jsonl held
100+ think events for that session.
